title: Portal Office Encounter
description: A woman in a dark retro dress and pearl necklace stands behind a wooden reception desk, looking down at a small man wearing a fedora who stands on the desk. They are framed within a swirling purple and teal cosmic portal that reveals a vintage office with old computer monitors and furniture.
prompt: A surreal retro scene viewed through a swirling cosmic portal of purple, teal and magenta energy. Inside a vintage office, a tall elegant woman in a dark 1950s-style dress with pearls stands behind a wooden desk, looking down at a tiny man in a fedora and suit standing on the desk surface. Old computer monitors and office furniture visible in the background, painterly brushwork, atmospheric and mysterious lighting.
